Small molecules are used as the basic units in the synthesis of large food molecules.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: Amino acids are basic units of carbohydrates.
Fatty acids are basic units of glycogen.
Glycerol is a basic unit of oils.
Simple sugar is a basic unit of protein.

questions.questionText:

release magnesium ions into the soil.
How would this benefit the plants?

options.text: prevents pests from eating the leaves
prevents the leaves from going yellow
prevents water loss from the leaves
